data.name: Binding automatically enables the built-in on-call email: To is the registered email addresses of all current on-call engineers (OCE), and CC is the on-call group's configured address. This cannot be disabled individually in push settings; unbinding stops new on-call emails. Application-specific custom channels remain independent, and binding does not grant the application access permissions.
data.value: Binding automatically enables the built-in on-call email: the To field contains the registered email addresses of all current on-call engineers (OCE), and the CC field contains the address configured for the on-call group. This cannot be disabled separately in the push settings; unbinding stops new on-call emails. Application-specific custom channels remain independent, and binding does not grant the application access permissions.

data.name: Each application can be bound to one on-call group; a group can serve multiple applications. Select “No on-call group” to unbind. Applications that only receive incidents do not require on-call configuration.
data.value: Each application can be assigned to one on-call group, and each group can serve multiple applications. Select “No on-call group” to remove the assignment. Applications that only receive incidents do not need on-call configuration.
